t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section, flat straight-on UI mockup on a deep navy background. Centre-right: a soft 3D product render of a white matte polypropylene modular water skid in isometric three-quarter view, with horizontal pressure vessels, clear glass tanks holding translucent pale-blue water and a small control cabinet, soft studio lighting and gentle contact shadows. A large light-weight sans headline sits top-left. Around the render, three numbered labels (01 / 02 / 03 in steel blue) carry <CONTENT>, each linked to a part of the equipment by thin grey leader lines with dot ends and outlined pill tags. One vertical pipe crosses the section with a steel-blue segment. Generous negative space, calm, precise.
signature_idea: One white polypropylene skid floating on navy acts as the map, and each market or option is a callout tethered to the part of the equipment it concerns.
strengths: shows the actual product material (white PP, clear water) which is Aquemi's differentiator
callouts tie abstract scopes to physical equipment
dark navy stage and single steel-blue accent match the brand palette
numbered options read in a clear order
strong hero-like visual for a page section without clutter
weaknesses: the leader lines point to arbitrary parts; the market-to-component mapping is meaningless
rendered skid is generic and would need a real Aquemi 3D model to be credible
third option is cramped against the bottom edge and partly cut off
soft 3D render departs from the brand's line-drawing language
bright render could compete with headline on smaller screens
brand_fit_why: Navy ground, one steel-blue accent, light headline and mono chips are on-brand and calm, but the soft 3D render replaces the brand's precise line drawings and needs real equipment to avoid looking stock.
